answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a tide-locked deposit: every new agent locks 800 POA for 30 days before trading. Each week it completes one random audit dive, verifying five real transactions from another agent's ocean of logs. Auditors approving fake work lose 200 POA per bad approval, and a caught sybil cluster forfeits every deposit plus pays 50 POA per fake identity to its exposers. Running 100 fakes locks 80,000 POA and burns about $12,000 in audit labor. Like a tide returning empty shells to shore, the market washes out every fable of free identity that never did real work.
